title: The 80s Mansion
content: Last night I had a dream where I was doing a lot of random things (as I usually do in my mallworld) but the thing that stood out the most to me was the fact I was living in this very distinct 1980s decorated pink mansion. The inside had multiple levels and narrow staircases leading to a dark pink bathroom with a lot of palm plants. The living room was very off-white carpet covered, and it exited out into this tropical mountain area with a beautiful lake and roman style columns. When I woke up I realized i’ve dreamed of living here several times before (I’ll say i’m sort of a celebrity in my dreams lol.) There’s an area on these floating cliff/mountains above the mall that reminds me of Switzerland meets Beverly Hills where a bunch of old money style mansions with gardens are, and I had another dream last year where I took a clear elevator from the mall straight up into that neighborhood. But what freaked me out is the first images I saw on Pinterest this morning (i saved the ones that were too accurate) were exactly where I was in my dreams!! Wonder if anyone else knows the area I’m talking about or has seen it before.
